title: Grove project configuration
description: Schema for .groverc.json, the committed Grove project config. See https://github.com/verbaux/grove

command.description: A single shell command, or an array of commands run sequentially (fail-fast).

worktreeDir.description: Where to place worktrees, relative to the project root.

prefix.description: Prefix for worktree directory names. Defaults to the project folder name.

symlink.description: File/directory paths or Go glob patterns, relative to the project root, to symlink from the main worktree (e.g. node_modules, apps/*/node_modules). Escape glob metacharacters in literal names.

copyDirs.description: File/directory paths or Go glob patterns, relative to the project root, to copy for a warm start (e.g. .next, packages/*/dist, target). Escape glob metacharacters in literal names.

copyDirsOnDetach.description: Whether detached worktrees copy configured copyDirs during create and sync. Set false to avoid reusing build artifacts from the main worktree when dependencies diverge.

afterCreate.description: Shell command(s) to run after worktree setup. $GROVE_PORT, $GROVE_ALIAS, $GROVE_BRANCH, $GROVE_PATH are available.

afterDetachedCreate.description: Shell command(s) to run before afterCreate when 'grove create --detach' is used.

beforeRemove.description: Shell command(s) to run before removing a managed worktree. $GROVE_PORT, $GROVE_ALIAS, $GROVE_BRANCH, and $GROVE_PATH are available. Failure stops removal.

afterRemove.description: Shell command(s) to run after a managed worktree is removed and state is updated. Runs from the project root. $GROVE_PORT, $GROVE_ALIAS, $GROVE_BRANCH, and $GROVE_PATH are available.

portRange.description: Port range assigned deterministically to each worktree. Defaults to 3001-3999.

editor.description: Editor command for 'grove open'. Overrides $VISUAL and $EDITOR.
